scene_summary: A small tiled bedroom with a foreground bed, white shelving and cabinet, two floor lamps, an open wooden door, and a white furnishing at right.
overall_evidence: The reconstruction captures the main furniture arrangement and tiled room, but the camera framing, door presentation, lighting, floor appearance, and several furniture details visibly differ. This score is an initial automated judgment, not a human rating or validated metric.

main_defects.description: The viewpoint is wider and lower-looking: the bed occupies more of the lower-right image, the door is narrower and farther back, and the left foreground wall/window framing is largely absent.
main_defects.evidence: In the reference the open door is a broad foreground panel near the center-right; in the reconstruction it is a thin panel near the back center. The bed also projects differently across the frame.
main_defects.uncertainty: Some differences may reflect actual object placement or door angle rather than camera alone.

main_defects.description: The warm illuminated wall patches and pronounced lighting variation in the reference are missing; the reconstruction is uniformly cool and flat.
main_defects.evidence: The reference back lamp casts bright warm pools above and beside its shade, while no comparable glow appears around the reconstruction lamp.
main_defects.uncertainty: The images may use different exposure or rendering settings.

main_defects.description: The floor loses the reference's mottled tan and dark gray regions, and the door and bedding appear more uniformly colored and simplified.
main_defects.evidence: The reference shows irregular tan floor coloration by the door, dark floor areas, and visible wood grain on the door; the reconstruction shows a mostly uniform gray floor and plain pale door.
main_defects.uncertainty: Some floor color variation could be lighting or a floor covering rather than underlying material.

main_defects.description: The cabinet's upper doors read as opaque panels rather than the reference's visibly glazed openings with dark interior shelves.
main_defects.evidence: The reference cabinet has two dark translucent upper panes revealing the interior; the reconstruction's upper panels are nearly solid white.
main_defects.uncertainty: The reconstruction panels could be transparent but rendered without enough contrast to show the interior.

main_defects.description: The left lamp is much shorter relative to the shelving, with its shade overlapping the middle of the shelf instead of standing near the shelf top.
main_defects.evidence: The reference left lamp shade begins near the upper edge of the shelving; the reconstruction shade begins well below that edge.
main_defects.uncertainty: Perspective and differences in lamp depth may contribute to the apparent height difference.

strengths: The white open shelving and adjacent narrow cabinet are present in the correct general order along the back wall.
Both slender floor lamps, the foreground bed, open pale wooden door, tiled walls, baseboards, and right-side white furnishing are represented.
The scene retains the reference's compact room layout and predominantly white furnishings.
uncertainty: Assessment is limited to the visible images; occluded or out-of-frame geometry cannot be evaluated. Differences in perspective and illumination can make object dimensions, positions, and materials appear different.
